en: Illustrated postcard showing a man in historical costume: a red jacket with gold buttons, white necktie, dark knee-breeches, white stockings, shoes with buckles, and a wide-brimmed hat. He holds a long staff topped with a colorful bouquet and ribbons. Decorative German text is written in a script at the top, and an artist's signature appears at the lower right. A black bar with the logo and name 'OÖ Landes-Kultur GmbH' is printed at the bottom margin.
